name: Promote Release Candidate to Stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'Release Candidate tag (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate RC tag and stable tag
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      rc_tag: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Validate inputs and fetch commit info
        id: validate
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          echo "Validating RC tag: $RC_TAG"
          
          # Verify RC tag format
          if ! [[ $RC_TAG =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: RC tag must match format vX.Y.Z-rcN"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Extract stable tag from RC tag
          STABLE_TAG=$(echo "$RC_TAG" | sed 's/-rc[0-9]*$//')
          echo "Stable tag will be: $STABLE_TAG"
          
          # Check if RC tag exists
          if ! git rev-parse "$RC_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Error: RC tag '$RC_TAG' does not exist"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if stable tag already exists
          if git rev-parse "$STABLE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Error: Stable tag '$STABLE_TAG' already exists"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Get commit SHA
          COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse "$RC_TAG")
          echo "Commit SHA: $COMMIT_SHA"
          
          echo "rc_tag=$RC_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "stable_tag=$STABLE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "commit_sha=$COMMIT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  promote:
    name: Promote RC to stable
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Tag Docker images with stable version
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}"
          STABLE_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          COMMIT_SHA="${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}"
          
          # Tag grafana/beyla image
          echo "Tagging grafana/beyla:$RC_TAG as grafana/beyla:$STABLE_TAG"
          docker buildx imagetools create -t grafana/beyla:$STABLE_TAG grafana/beyla:$RC_TAG
          
          # Tag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache image
          echo "Tagging grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:$RC_TAG as grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:$STABLE_TAG"
          docker buildx imagetools create -t grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:$STABLE_TAG grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:$RC_TAG

      - name: Create stable git tag
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}"
          STABLE_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          COMMIT_SHA="${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}"
          
          echo "Creating stable tag $STABLE_TAG pointing to commit $COMMIT_SHA"
          git tag -a "$STABLE_TAG" -m "Stable release $STABLE_TAG" "$COMMIT_SHA"
          git push origin "$STABLE_TAG"

      - name: Copy release assets from RC to stable
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}"
          STABLE_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          
          # Get release ID for RC tag
          RC_RELEASE_ID=$(gh release view "$RC_TAG" --json id -q '.id')
          
          # List assets in RC release
          ASSETS=$(gh release view "$RC_TAG" --json assets -q '.assets[].name')
          
          # Copy each asset to stable release
          for asset in $ASSETS; do
            echo "Copying asset: $asset"
            gh release upload "$STABLE_TAG" "./$asset" --clobber
          done

      - name: Create stable GitHub release
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}"
          STABLE_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          COMMIT_SHA="${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}"
          
          # Generate release notes
          RELEASE_NOTES=$(gh release view "$RC_TAG" --json body -q '.body')
          
          # Create stable release
          gh release create "$STABLE_TAG" \
            --title "$STABLE_TAG" \
            --notes "$RELEASE_NOTES" \
            --target "$COMMIT_SHA" \
            --draft=false \
            --prerelease=false

      - name: Notify about manual follow-ups
        run: |
          echo "=== Manual Follow-Up Checklist ==="
          echo "1. Publish Helm chart updates"
          echo "2. Update technical documentation"
          echo "3. Announce stable release in appropriate channels"
          echo "=================================="
